status: AI-assisted draft claims; qualified linguistic and scholarly review pending
translation_policy: The original is the evidence. English translations below are provisional AI-assisted aids. None is a certified translation, scholarly approval, fatwa or product approval.

claims.claim: The answer treats permission as dependent on ingredients, contamination/intoxicants and health; a product-specific determination remains necessary.
claims.original_excerpt: حلت یا حرمت کا دو ٹوک فیصلہ کرنا ممکن نہیں
claims.draft_translation: A categorical determination of permissibility or prohibition is not possible.
claims.scope_limit: Conditional answer about cell-proliferated meat, not blanket Pakistani permission or a certificate.

claims.locator: Fatwa 144012201327; conclusion after conditions, then quoted Arabic commentary
claims.claim: The answer recommends avoidance pending firm knowledge of the listed conditions. Its Arabic citation is an attributed classical basis within the local answer.
claims.original_excerpt: لیبارٹری کے گوشت سے بچنا بہتر ہے
claims.draft_translation: It is better to avoid laboratory meat.

quoted_basis.original_excerpt: إذ حل الأكل متوقف على تحقق الذكاة الشرعية
quoted_basis.draft_translation: Since permission to eat depends on establishing lawful slaughter.
quoted_basis.local_citation: حاشية على مراقي الفلاح شرح نور الإيضاح,1/24, Bulaq imprint as cited by Banuri
quoted_basis.status: Local body's quoted basis; original classical edition not independently collated; no foreign council added.

claims.scope_limit: Question mixes animal/plant laboratory routes. Retain route conditions; advice is not a universal prohibition or proof of subsequent product failure.

claims.locator: Landing post metadata; Urdu pp 1–2 and 22; Arabic p 1
claims.claim: Muhammad Muaz Ashraf authors the work; Muhammad Taqi Usmani supplies an introductory endorsement mentioning consultation.
claims.chronology: Post date 17 October 2023; modified 9 December 2025; Urdu issue footers November/December 2023. These dates describe different publication layers.
claims.scope_limit: Institutionally hosted authored analysis; do not relabel it as a Taqi-authored national fatwa, unanimous council resolution or product certificate.

claims.locator: Urdu PDFp 22/printed 38 finalparagraph; Arabic PDFp 14/printed 33 leftcolumn conclusion
claims.claim: The conclusion distinguishes lawful slaughtered donors, an exception for parts not bearing life, and prohibited admixtures; transformation is conditional and not simply presumed.
claims.original_excerpt: پھر کسی بھی مرحلے پر حرام کی آمیزش نہ ہو
claims.parallel_excerpt: ثم يلزم أن لا يحصل اختلاطه بحرام في أي مرحلة
claims.draft_translation: Then there must be no admixture with prohibited material at any stage.
claims.scope_limit: Two language witnesses of one work. Detailed biological and istihala reasoning is not independently validated; no inference about any manufacturer's actual inputs.

claims.locator: Urdu PDFp 19, حلال سرٹیفکٹ, items 1–5; issuer English onepage resolution
claims.claim: The certification resolution connects expert religious judgment, credible testing and continuing oversight.
claims.original_excerpt: حلال سرٹیفکٹ جاری کرنا بڑی ذمہ داری کا کام ہے
claims.draft_translation: Issuing a halal certificate is a grave responsibility.
claims.scope_limit: General certification conditions from the 1–3 March 2015 Kerala seminar; no cultivated-specific ruling. English/Urdu are one institutional source family.

claims.locator: PDFp 14, AI adopted decisions, item 3; p 15top item 6. Questions onp 8 excluded as operative evidence.
claims.claim: The AI resolution cautions that generated information may mislead and references may be fabricated; it calls for research/verification.
claims.original_excerpt: اپنی تحقیق سے مزید نکھار پیدا کرلیں
claims.draft_translation: Improve it further through one's own research.
claims.scope_limit: General AI use at the 9–11 November 2024 Bihar seminar; not approval for AI to issue halal certificates or for cultivated food.

claims.claim: The published scheme requests composition/process and supplier evidence and separates the certification decision from the client's auditors.
claims.scope_limit: Own scheme text only; broad categories do not demonstrate a cultivated-product certificate or legal permission to sell.

claims.locator: PC 038 validity/scope; PHA localHCBrow 7; PHA registration/product-mark headings
claims.claim: Official registers support checking a named certification body's status, scope and dates separately from a product certificate.
claims.scope_limit: HIPL accreditation is slaughterhouse scope; PHA body registration is not product certification. Dynamic list status may conflict with expiry fields; retain snapshots and do not infer aggregate current counts.

claims.claim: The historical DBT-BIRAC call includes AI optimization for fermentation monitoring and predictive control as a research objective.
claims.scope_limit: An objective is not an awarded grant, functioning system, measured improvement, safety decision or halal certificate.
